'''Mikael Khalindar II''' was the Khalindarian emperor who represented Khalindar at the [[Solaran-Khalindarian Conference of 1940]]. His government entered the anti-Vesperan war effort after Solara offered territorial, economic, infrastructure, and military incentives.

== Conference Role ==

Mikael II sought to use the [[Avant Great War]] to expand Khalindar's territory and influence. He accepted Solara's wartime offer because it promised postwar gains from Vesperan-held lands and gave Khalindar a stronger role in the regional order.

== Postwar Dispute ==

The failure to deliver the expected settlement damaged Mikael II's legacy and became a lasting grievance inside Khalindar. Later Khalindarian governments treated the 1940 promises as evidence that Solara had exploited Khalindar's wartime loyalty.
